Consolidate note into a single paragraph:

```suggestion
				[b]Note:[/b] While measuring the Earth's magnetic field, due to how the Earth's magnetic field works, the returned vector may [b]not[/b] point directly to the north depending on where you're located. In the northern hemisphere, this vector points into the ground, but is tilted towards the north. On the equator, it should point directly to the north. ```
```

It's a bit long, but the rest of the text belongs to this note. If we adopt https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111375, we need to ensure notes encompass the entire text that goes with them.

body:
It might be worth mentioning that the X and Y axes are always in the screen plane, with Y+ pointing up in the current device orientation.

I see you listed X+/X- as left/right, and I think this is the same logic as for the diagrams I made, so those should be X+ right, Y+ top, and Z+ "closer". With your device standing on its edge in portrait mode, you should get a -9.8 value along Y, as you wrote. With the device lying screen up, you would get -9.8 along Z.
